svg.title: Pointed conductor in a uniform field
svg.desc: Computed field lines around a neutral, lens-shaped conductor with pointed ends, placed in a field that was uniform and pointing to the right. The lines meet the surface at right angles. They are concentrated very strongly at the two sharp tips, where the induced charge is most dense: negative at the left tip, positive at the right tip. Along the broad curved sides the lines are sparse, so the field there is small. There is no field inside the conductor.
